title: Skeletons and Monsters
voice: Unsigned gallery voice; curation/voice/style-guide.md as amended 2026-10-16 (Feeling and message)
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Depth pass, October 16, 2026. Every work was inspected again from the published WebP at 640 px as one wall and at 1200 px for the labelled works. Dates and stroke counts come from data/gallery.json; the May 1 and May 5, 2022 purchases from the Gnosis ledger (curation/research/onchain/); the artist's March 2, 2022 post from curation/research/social/x-posts.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 20 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Two kinds of body share this room. One is a skeleton: a stick figure of bones, drawn in a few colored lines, dancing or walking on a flat ground. The other is a monster: a hunched, furred or armored creature in the dark, with fangs. Twenty works, from New Year's Day 2022 to June 3. The skeletons are the series at play. The monsters are what it drew when it stopped playing.

The skeletons are all limbs. Their arms and legs bend at too many joints, their hands are spread like rakes, and their heads are small skulls with teeth. Most of them wear something: a jacket, a tutu, a hat. They are dead and they are dancing, and the joke never wears out. The monsters are all mass. They crouch, they fill the square, and the light picks out teeth and eyes and leaves the rest in shadow. The artist painted them with the care the skeletons never asked for, and the care is where the dread comes from.

This is also the room where the collecting began. Jamie Thingelstad's first purchase from the series was the skeleton that opens it, the horned figure in a jacket from New Year's Day, bought on May 1, 2022, for twenty xDai. Four days later he bought the blue bull walking through fire. The two kinds do not alternate neatly. Watch the stick figures loosen through February, then see the monsters take over in April and May, until the last work is a creature hanging in a dark forest.

chapters.title: New Year Skeletons
chapters.opening: Three stick figures from the first three days of 2022, then the first monster at the end of the month. The first of them became the collector's first purchase from the series.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #16
works.text: A horned figure in a jacket stands square on an olive ground, drawn in black with a cream fill, its ribs showing through the coat like a fossil. Thin red and yellow lines wander over the whole square in loose rectangles, as if a second drawing had been laid on the first. The hands are two rakes of fingers. The year 2022 begins with this work, made in the morning of January 1, and four months later it began something else: on May 1, 2022, it was the first New Nifty on the Block that Jamie Thingelstad bought, for twenty xDai, seventeen days after his first nnxyz purchase of any kind. A skeleton in a jacket, standing its ground with its ribs showing, was the one he chose first.
works.caption: A horned figure in a jacket on olive, ribs showing through, thin red and yellow lines wandering over it.
works.reading: The jacket is drawn with two lapels and a dark collar, and the ribs are three curved strokes on each side of the chest. The horns are short and curved. The red and yellow lines never touch the figure's outline; they travel around it in right angles, like wiring.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #17
works.text: A stick figure in a pink tutu stands on one leg like a pole, arms out, its head a ball of red scribble with two round eyes.
works.caption: A stick figure in a pink tutu balances on one pole of a leg, its head red scribble.
works.reading: The body is one upright line from the base to the head, with the tutu drawn as a fan of pink and yellow loops around the hips. The arms end in two knots of line for hands. A soft shadow in yellow and grey sits behind the figure, the one modelled thing in the drawing.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #18
works.text: A lanky figure in blue and orange line dances on teal, one arm raised high in a loop, its small skull grinning with white fangs.
works.caption: A lanky figure in blue and orange line dances on teal, one arm looped high, a small fanged skull.
works.reading: The limbs are drawn as long tubes of orange, blue and green scribble edged in white, and they bend at the elbows and knees more than once. The head is a small skull with two red eyes, a yellow crest and a row of white fangs. A knot of scribble at the hip is the only solid part.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #26
works.text: A skeleton painted in dark purple and grey emerges from black, its skull tilted toward you, its ribcage open, one hand held up with the fingers spread. Light catches the top of the skull, the knuckles and the edges of the ribs, and everything else sinks into the ground. It is the first painted body in the room, and the first with no color at all beyond the purple of the bone. The stick skeletons of the first week were dancing. This one has stopped, turned, and raised a hand, and the raised hand is the whole difference: a joke about death, painted with enough care, is no longer a joke.
works.caption: A painted skeleton in dark purple and grey rises from black, skull tilted, one hand raised with fingers spread.
works.reading: The skull has two pointed ears or horns and a crack running down from the crown. The raised hand is drawn with every finger separate, and the ribs are shown as a set of curved plates with the dark between them. It is the most densely drawn work of the winter here.

chapters.title: February: Hats and Fangs
chapters.opening: Eight works in three weeks. Skeletons put on hats and cowboy boots, and between them the monsters arrive, one with fangs and one with a grin.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #27
works.text: A hunched creature with a long skull, a red mouth of white fangs and two red eyes crouches in grey light, its fur drawn in a halo of black and white scratches. Four days after the purple skeleton, the painted body is back, but furred, with hands planted on the ground and a spine of spikes down its back. The dark around it is not flat; it is made of soft grey discs, like a fog. The mouth is the only red thing, and it is open. It is the first monster in the series that is plainly angry, and it arrived on February 2, 2022, with nothing in the record to explain it except the drawing itself.
works.caption: A hunched creature with a long skull and red fanged mouth crouches in grey fog, its fur scratched.
works.reading: The skull has two horns and is drawn in grey over black with white lines for the edges. The fangs are a row of white triangles in a red mouth, and red runs from the mouth down the chest. The fur is drawn in long outward strokes of black, white, orange and blue, and the ground is a cloud of overlapping grey circles. It is the most densely drawn work in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #28
works.text: Two skeletons in yellow and pink line meet on orange, one bending low and the other reaching down, their skulls grinning with white fangs.
works.caption: Two skeletons in yellow and pink line meet on orange, one bending low, both grinning with white fangs.
works.reading: The two figures are drawn in the same colors, yellow, pink and black, so they are hard to tell apart where their limbs cross in the middle. The one at the upper right has a pointed skull with red eyes. The one on the left has a flat head and a loop of line for a collar. Two feet at the bottom end in white claws.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #29
works.caption: A boxy creature with cat ears and a wide white grin, in colored scribble over a grey grid.
works.reading: The body is a rectangle of colored scribble with thin pink lines running around it in squares, and the arms and legs stick out at angles. The head has two pointed ears, two round pink eyes and a grin that spans the whole face. Four white claws, each a row of triangles, sit at the ends of the limbs.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #30
works.text: A skeleton in a tall yellow hat stands on teal, its boxy body striped with pink, red and yellow, both arms held out and its ribs drawn in white.
works.caption: A skeleton in a tall yellow hat, its boxy body striped pink, red and yellow, ribs drawn in white.
works.reading: The hat has a wide brim and a tall crown, drawn in yellow and black line. The body is a box filled with vertical stripes, with the ribs and a pelvis drawn over them in white. The arms are long and thin with rake hands, and the feet are two dark blocks with white claws.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #31
works.text: A cowboy skeleton strides to the left on orange, hat tipped, one leg raised, its chest a box of blue and red scribble with a heart in it.
works.caption: A cowboy skeleton strides left on orange, hat tipped, one leg raised, a heart in its scribbled chest.
works.reading: The hat is drawn in brown with a dark band, and the skull beneath it grins with a row of teeth. The chest is a box filled with blue, red and yellow scribble, and the heart in it is drawn in red loops. A soft orange shadow sits under the raised foot. The hands are rakes with white claws.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #32
works.text: A hunched figure in yellow, pink and blue scribble crouches on olive, its boxy head open at the front with two staring eyes and a row of teeth.
works.caption: A hunched scribbled figure crouches on olive, two staring eyes and teeth inside its open box of a head.
works.reading: The head is drawn as a box with a notch cut out of the front, and inside the notch are two round eyes and a grid of teeth. The body and limbs are long tubes of scribble with white highlights. A black shadow sits under the figure, drawn as a blot.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #33
works.text: A purple figure with a round head and a wide grin of white teeth holds out its arms in the dark, its eyes two red X marks, the grin and the cancelled eyes together for the first time in the room.
works.caption: A purple figure with a round head and a wide white grin holds out its arms in the dark.
works.reading: The head is painted in purple and green with scribble over it, and the grin is a row of white teeth from one side of the face to the other. The X marks sit in white eye sockets. The body is small and the arms are stubby, drawn with white edges on the black.

chapters.title: Wings, Crowns and Cowboys
chapters.opening: March and April. A moth, a crowned skeleton on a maze, a horned creature, and two more cowboys, one dancing on red and one walking downhill.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #39
works.text: A moth with wings of gold and black stripes spreads them across a purple ground, its small red face at the top with two antennae. The body is a stack of striped segments, and the wings are drawn in long curved strokes that follow their shape. Two round tips hang below like feet. It is the one winged creature in the room, and the most carefully built, with 380 recorded strokes. It was made on March 2, 2022, the day the artist posted a list of reasons for loving Nifty Ink: easy and fun, works without problems, no cost to mint, a nice and active community. The moth is that mood with wings on. It is also drawn to a lamp.
works.caption: A moth with gold and black striped wings spread wide on purple, a small red face with two antennae.
works.reading: The stripes on the wings are drawn in gold, brown and white, with the strokes curving to make the wings cup forward. The face is a red mask with two black eyes and a small white mouth, and the antennae end in curls. Small yellow and purple squiggles float in the dark around the wings.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #41
works.caption: A crowned skeletal figure with red ribs stands on a black maze of pink and yellow lines.
works.reading: The crown is a row of spikes on a boxy head, and the ribs and pelvis are drawn in red and white over a grey fill. The maze is made of thin pink and yellow lines that turn at right angles around the whole square. Soft blobs of blue and tan sit behind the lines.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #47
works.text: A horned creature made of colored scribble crouches on all fours in the dark, two round eyes and a mouth of white fangs in its square head.
works.caption: A horned creature of colored scribble crouches on all fours in the dark, white fangs in a square head.
works.reading: The fur is drawn as dense scribble in white, yellow, blue and red over a grey fill, and the whole creature is edged in white. Its eyes are two rings with pupils, set wide apart. Soft grey beams cross the black behind it, like light through a window.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #54
works.text: A cowboy skeleton dances on red, one arm up and one out, white lines of motion curving around it and three white squiggles rising from its hat.
works.caption: A cowboy skeleton dances on red, arms up and out, white lines of motion curving around it.
works.reading: The figure is drawn in blue, yellow and pink scribble with black outlines, and the hat is a wide dark brim with a purple crown. The motion lines are thin white arcs drawn in sets on both sides, and the squiggles above the hat rise like steam. The red ground is flat.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #55
works.text: A metallic figure with red X eyes walks down a black slope on lime green, its body drawn in grey and blue with white highlights.
works.caption: A shining metallic figure with red X eyes leans into a walk down a black slope on lime.
works.reading: The slope runs from the lower left to the right, and the figure leans into it with one arm out behind. The body is drawn in short grey and blue strokes with white edges, so it shines. The head is a long oval with two red X marks and a small mouth.

chapters.title: Monsters
chapters.opening: The last four works, from April 25 to June 3, are all monsters, and all painted. The skeletons are gone. The second of them, the bull, was bought the day it was drawn.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #57
works.text: A blob of a monster fills the square from the black, its mouth a cave of white teeth, its two eyes on stalks with orange lids. The body is drawn in green and brown with scribble over it, and a hand at the upper right holds up a small round thing. In February a purple figure grinned with a row of teeth; here the grin has become the whole body, and the eyes have left the head. It was drawn on April 25, 2022, the same day as the two cats with a heart between them in the room next door, and the same day the artist gave the collector the drawing that marked two hundred inks. One hand and one day made a love note and this.
works.caption: A blob of a monster with a cave of white teeth and two eyes on stalks fills the dark.
works.reading: The teeth are drawn as a ring of white wedges with grey shadow between them, and the mouth is open wide enough to show the dark inside. The eye stalks are two tubes with white eyeballs on the ends, each with an orange ring and a black pupil. The body is lumpy and the surface is built from short colored strokes over a green fill.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #66
works.text: A blue bull with small horns walks through orange fire, its back and legs drawn in blue and green scribble, a bouquet of smoke rising from its tail; the collector bought it on May 5, 2022, the day after it was drawn, for fifteen xDai, four days before the market fell.
works.caption: A blue bull with small horns walks through orange fire, smoke rising from its tail.
works.reading: The fire is painted in soft orange and yellow discs with red at the edges, and the ground under the bull is scratched with yellow lines. The bull's body is blue and teal with scribble over it in blue and yellow. The tail ends in a cluster of pale grey shapes like flowers or smoke.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #128
works.text: A furry creature with a huge mane of colored strokes grins with white fangs, one red eye showing, on a ground of yellow circles.
works.caption: A furry creature with a huge colored mane grins with white fangs, one red eye showing, on yellow.
works.reading: The mane is drawn in long strokes of orange, blue, purple and yellow radiating from the head, and the fur on the body is painted in the same colors. The grin is a curved row of white fangs with a black gap. The yellow ground is made of soft overlapping circles.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #138
works.text: A hunched creature with long hair and long thin arms hangs in a dark forest, drawn in black and gold strokes between tall black tree trunks, the sky behind it burning orange. Its face looks down and is barely there. The hands reach toward the ground. It is the last work in the room, made June 3, 2022, and the only one where the monster has a place to be: a forest, with trees and a sky, and the sky is on fire. After five months of skeletons that danced and monsters that roared, the series ends its first part with a creature that has gone quiet and is looking at the ground. Whatever the fire behind it is, it has turned its back on it.
works.caption: A hunched long-haired creature with thin arms hangs between black tree trunks in a dark forest under orange.
works.reading: The trees are drawn as tall black strokes with branches scratched in at the top, and the orange sky is painted in soft bands behind them. The creature's hair is a mass of gold and brown strokes that fall over its shoulders. Its face is a few strokes of grey and brown with two dark eyes.

closing: Look again at the first skeleton, standing square in its jacket on New Year's Day, and then at the creature hanging in the forest in June. The one is all bone and line on a flat ground, and it is a joke about being dead. The other is all hair and shadow in a place with trees, and it is not a joke. The room walked from one to the other in five months, and the collector's first two purchases from the series, the New Year skeleton and the bull in the fire, stand at the two ends of the walk.
